summary: The change is a clean pure move and passes. It moves unmet_criteria, left_to_athena, marked_left, is_athena_check_criterion, send_back_text, criterion_key and mod left_to_athena_tests from run/mod.rs into the new run/send_back.rs. The only other code edits are import lines and a `pub(crate) use` re-export, so the crate::run:: paths still resolve. I read the diff line by line and found the moved function text unchanged; the tests changed only in two use lines that replace names they used to get through `super::*`. Caller check: run_pin_tests.rs is the only file outside run/ that calls crate::run::unmet_criteria or send_back_text, and it is untouched. Athena's records show fmt, clippy and the full test suite passed (1617 tests). I ran the four left_to_athena_tests myself: they pass under their old names, now with the prefix run::send_back. CHANGELOG.md has an entry, and only the three expected files changed. My one attempt to check the moved lines with git's moved-line colouring could not be read back (the output file was outside my working directory, so access was denied), so the moved-text check rests on reading the diff by hand. One minor finding: the design doc says tests stay in mod.rs during R1-R8, which conflicts with its own R2 row; this needs a later doc fix, not a change here.
